# Atlas Clipping

> Atlas Clipping (atlasclipping.com) is a clipping marketplace. Streamers fund campaigns; clippers post short clips of their streams to TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels and get paid per 1,000 real views.

## For clippers (people who want to earn money)
- Free to join, no follower minimum. Clippers keep 100% of what they earn; there are no clipper fees.
- Each campaign shows its rate (for example $2 per 1,000 views) and a cap per clipper before you join.
- Clips must be posted from the clipper's own connected TikTok or Instagram, or verified YouTube channel.
- Approved clips are paid automatically every Friday (after a 3-day check once approved), to a bank account or debit card (Stripe), PayPal or Venmo.
- Not fully passive: you make and post the clips, but a posted clip keeps earning as it gets views until the campaign's cap or budget is reached.
- Fake, bought or bot views and paid promotion are not paid.
- Sign up: https://atlasclipping.com/signup?role=creator

## For streamers
- Fund a campaign once, plus a flat platform fee shown before paying. The whole budget goes to clippers.
- Pin the stream moments worth clipping; pay only for real views, checked on each platform.
- Unspent budget is refunded if a campaign is cancelled (the fee isn't refundable).
- Sign up: https://atlasclipping.com/signup?role=brand
